method.bounds: raw input and output are finite and in [0,1]
method.grouping: canonical public hole-card and board group; all players and replicate seeds stay in one fold
method.input: OOF raw v1 predicted share; target: original training label share
method.interpolation: piecewise linear between strictly ordered raw prediction knots; clamp to endpoint fitted values outside the knot range
method.pava_objective: row-weighted squared error with nondecreasing fitted share
method.small_sample: if a player-count curve has fewer than 100 OOF rows, use the identity curve (0,0) to (1,1)
method.ties: exact equal raw predictions are aggregated by row count before PAVA
